definitions.explanation: A site where minerals, metals, or other geological materials are extracted from the earth. Composed of 鉱 (ore/mineral) + 山 (mountain).

examples.english: Gold is mined at this mine.

examples.japanese: {廃|はい}{鉱山|こうざん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{観光地|かんこうち}→観光地：14163_kankouchi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{整備|せいび}→整備：04037_seibi⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An abandoned mine was developed as a tourist attraction.

examples.japanese: {鉱山|こうざん}⟦{労働者|ろうどうしゃ}→労働者：23971_roudousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Safety measures for mine workers have become a major issue.

notes:
USAGE:
{鉱山|こうざん} refers to any type of mine for extracting minerals or metals. Japan has several historically significant mines, including the {石見|いわみ}{銀山|ぎんざん} (Iwami Silver Mine), which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {金|きん}{鉱山|こうざん} (gold mine)
- {銀|ぎん}{鉱山|こうざん} (silver mine)
- {銅|どう}{鉱山|こうざん} (copper mine)
- {廃|はい}{鉱山|こうざん} (abandoned mine)
- {鉱山|こうざん}⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧ (mine development)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{炭鉱|たんこう}→炭鉱：04504_tankou⟧ specifically refers to a coal mine. ⟦{採掘|さいくつ}→採掘：07996_saikutsu⟧ means "mining" or "excavation" as an activity.
